decisions.what: Conductor stops merging and rewriting history; the owner merges
decisions.why: Unattended runs are not allowed to merge or force-push without a human. Working around that is not acceptable.

decisions.what: Stacked tasks, up to 2 waiting for merge
decisions.why: So agent work continues while the owner has not merged yet

decisions.what: Cursor authors commits as the owner with a Co-authored-by trailer
decisions.why: Co-author trailers do not count on the contribution graph; authorship does. This removes the need for force-push rewrites.

decisions.what: Started Day 02 Part 1 stacked on day-01/monorepo-setup

problems: Playbook assumed the conductor could merge and force-push unattended. It cannot.
The owner was not reached effectively: two days of journal 'stuck' entries without a reply.
processNotes: Template rule: merges are always a human step. Design the flow so work continues without them (stacking).
Template rule: get commit authorship right at commit time, never by rewriting history later.
Escalation needs to be loud but rare: one message per evening, not hourly entries.
